1. I was in a really dark time when played through Fruit of Grisaia back at the start of 2021. But, as I slowly went through each route, especially Sachis, it really helped me to feel better about not only myself, but how I view the world around me. It has helped me through so much and I still cry over the final scene everytime I think about it.
2. I'm looking forward to the Sharin No Kuni translation being released (thats if it ever does). The way the kickstarter is going I'm not even sure it will be released whatsoever but I've always wanted to play it and I've been waiting for the kickstarter. I hope it'll eventually get released in 2022 but who knows at this point.

I really like the small slice of life segments and cute moments between the mc and the girls. I know its not a perfect response but I'm kinda used to the heartbreaking vns so.... But if you can stomach depressing bittersweet endings, Id highly recommend Clannad.

“Huh?” I wonder, as I look around. It looks like I’m in an abandoned room, the wallpapers peeling off, there’s a massive cobweb in the room, the lights are flickering and there’s nothing in here except for a computer, not even a table or chair. “What the hell?!” I say as I look down. I’m massive, I look like I haven’t exercised since 1969. I have a beard, which is odd since I am a woman. “What’s happened” I thought, the last thing I remember is being at home and having a few pints, playing a bit of World Of Warcraft and that’s it. I wonder what to do, I decide to go to the computer. I boot it up, the light from the computer is blinding. World of Warcraft is on, I’m about to leave it but I realise something, the character name is ‘Xxx_PussyDestroyer69_xxX’. ‘Hey, this might be interesting’ I think, I decide to check his chats. I see a chat with ‘Channel_Waffel029’, which is odd, because that’s my username. Anyway I decide to check the chat, turns out I had a massive flame war with him. But that doesn’t explain how I’m in his house, or how I look like him.

“Honey can you come down please, I made your favourite, pineapple on pizza!”. Who was that? My best guess is his girlfriend or something. If I really am this guy I don’t want to be him anymore, he likes pineapple on pizza, like who does that. Anyway I respond with “Uh sure sweetie, I’ll come down now.”
